items.title: SpaceX “Off Balance Sheet” Debt for AI Chips Hits the Market This Week. Here’s Where Things Get Interesting
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSome of a $40 billion debt package to buy Nvidia chips for SpaceX could go on sale as soon as this week, Bloomberg reported. The debt sits in a separate vehicle off SpaceX’s balance sheet, and critics like Ed Zitron want that kind of deal regulated away.

items.title: Apollo CEO Marc Rowan Says AI Boom Could Require Up to $8 Trillion, Reshape US Credit Markets
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) CEO Marc Rowan warned the artificial intelligence infrastructure boom could require as much as $8 trillion in financing, creating an unprecedented test for U.S. capital markets and potentially driving new financing structures across the AI ecosystem....

items.title: SpaceX is leasing $47 billion of Nvidia chips like a car — and lenders hold the title
items.summary: Leasing a car gets you the newest model for a monthly payment, and the bank keeps the title. SpaceX just signed the AI version on about $47 billion of Nvidia's newest chips.

items.title: SPCX Stock In Focus: SpaceX To Reportedly Launch $4B Bond Sale This Week
items.summary: The bond sale is part of a larger $40 billion financing to buy Nvidia’s Vera Rubin chips.

items.title: Mizuho starts coverage of asset managers, backs Apollo, Ares and Blackstone
items.summary: Investing.com -- Mizuho initiated coverage of nine asset managers, rating seven Outperform, including Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO), Ares Management (NYSE: ARES) and Blackstone (NYSE:BX).

items.title: SpaceX Debt for AI Chips to Hit Market as Soon as This Week
items.summary: A portion of $40 billion in debt financing to pay for artificial intelligence chips for SpaceX may start being sold as soon as this week, with Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. serving as underwriters on the expected deal, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

items.title: RIA aggregator Focus Financial secures investment from Apollo
items.summary: As per Bloomberg, Apollo is committing $2.5bn in a transaction that pegs Focus’s enterprise value, inclusive of debt.

items.title: Billionaire Mark Cuban Said ‘Chips As An Asset Class Will Be The New Crypto’ but Since He Posted It, Bitcoin Is Up 20% And Chip Stocks Are Down 24%
items.summary: Mark Cuban has made a series of unfortunate investing calls recently, as many calls go in opposite directions.
